description: Build (NOT execute) a buy or sell order for an xStock. Nothing is traded and no funds move: this returns a quote (details) and a Solana Pay link (solanaPayUrl). Show the details (amount in, expected out, fee) to the user and give them the link or QR code: their wallet opens it and they approve there with their OWN wallet. For a buy, `amount` is how much pay_token to spend. For a sell, `amount` is how many xStock to sell, in the units the wallet shows (up to 8 decimals), or "max" to sell the entire balance. If a referral partner is configured on this server, details.partnerFee shows the extra fee paid to that partner. xStocks are issued by Backed Finance AG and are NOT available to U.S. citizens or residents. Trading tokenized equities involves risk of loss.

amount.description: Buy: amount of pay_token to spend. Sell: amount of the xStock to sell in wallet units (number or decimal string, up to 8 decimals), or "max" to sell the whole balance.

include_transaction.description: Also return the base64 unsigned transaction. Only for agents that have their own wallet signer.

pay_token.description: The non-xStock side of the trade

wallet.description: The user's Solana wallet address (public address only, never a private key)

name: build_order
title: Build a buy/sell order
